CustomField.inlineHelpText: The org's daily cap for this channel. Not the per-transaction limit; that distinction cost a day of debugging once.
CustomField.label: Txn Email Limit
CustomField.description: Per-transaction ceiling from Limits.getLimitEmailInvocations(), not the org daily cap. On this org the transaction limit is 10 and the daily cap is 15; they are different numbers and conflating them hides an outage.
